Class Board

java.lang.Object
Board
public class Board extends Object
Represents the board of Jungle King consisting of multiple tiles, where each represents a different animal piece or special tile.

    • canCapture

      public boolean canCapture(Piece selectedPiece, Tile newTile, Tile currentTile)
      Determines if the selected piece can capture the opponent's piece on the new tile
      Parameters:
      selectedPiece - - the current player's piece
      newTile - - the location of the opponent's piece that the current player wants to capture
      currentTile - - the location of the current player's piece
      Returns:
      true if the player's piece can capture the opponent's piece, otherwise returns false
